name: parallax-hero-images

frames.best_why: Frame 5 shows all six photos apart and clear, with the headline fully legible between them.

tagline: Photo cards pin to the screen edges and drift gently with the cursor.
summary: Up to eight rounded photos pinned around the edges of a hero, each floating a little against the pointer at its own depth. It is a calm, blurred-in collage meant to sit behind headline copy.
appearance: A dark hero with six rounded photo cards around its margins: mountain ranges along the top, a laptop and a black sneaker at the sides, a figure in soft cloud and a single leaf at the bottom. Between them sit a small pill, a very large bold white headline and a short grey paragraph.
behaviour: Each photo stays pinned to its spot but glides up to forty pixels away from the pointer at its own depth on a spring, so the collage breathes as the cursor moves. On load the photos fade in one by one from blurred and slightly small.
demo_content: A Moodboard pill, the headline Collect what moves you, plus mountain, laptop, sneaker, cloud and leaf photos.
search_phrases: hero with floating photos around the edges
images that shift with the mouse
moodboard collage for a landing page
photo cards floating behind a headline
use_when: A landing hero wants a calm, editorial photo collage with gentle pointer depth.
avoid_when: Touch devices or narrow screens: the photos crowd the copy and the parallax cannot fire.
customise: images (up to eight) are placed in fixed edge spots; className and imageClassName restyle them, and variant swaps which photos move most. Positions and depth values are baked in.
weight_why: Six memoised images moved by two springs fed by one window mousemove listener.

a11y.note: The photos use empty alt text and the pointer parallax runs with no reduced-motion check.

issues: The headline, pill and copy belong to the demo, so the component on its own is only the photo layer.
On touch screens there is no pointer, so the photos sit still and the effect disappears.
polish_why: A calm, well-spaced collage with a gentle spring; it still needs the demo's copy to read as a hero.
title: Parallax Hero Images
